item.subject: science
item.stem:
The figure shows two length tools Farhan's class considers for measuring the same classroom board: a metre scale and one student's handspan. Someone also names the centimetre as the SI unit of length.

Which claim correctly decides whether a length unit is suitable as a standard unit?

options.A: The SI unit of length is the centimetre.
options.B: The metre is suitable as a shared standard length unit.
options.C: Each student's own handspan is a standard length unit.
options.D: The centimetre is not a standard length unit at all.
